{{Top|leg}}
'''Station 17''' was one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad's]] few remaining [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colonies. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the tanker [[Bastion (tanker)|''Bastion'']] was docked there when members of [[Wraith Squadron]] captured the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as well as its two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] escorts.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
